The giant Labor Day sales roll on at both Amazon and Best Buy alongside AirPods Pro 3 now back down at $50 off and all-time lows on AirTag 2 at $20 each. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by this 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR hitting the Amazon all-time low at $329 off (or up to $500 off via Apple refurb store) and the most affordable current-gen iPad Air at $100 off. We also have launch deal on Anker’s brand new MagGo 2 Pro Qi2.2 power bank with smart display and Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My, heart rate tracking, more now up to $92 off. Head below for a closer look.

Amazon’s massive 2026 Labor Day sale now live! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, more from under $5

Best Buy’s giant 2026 Labor Day sale is now live: Apple, Android phones, appliances $1,100 off, TVs, more

AirPods Pro 3 now $50 off in Amazon’s giant Labor Day sale

As part of its now live Labor Day sale, Amazon has now dropped the price on Apple’s latest AirPods Pro 3 back down to $199 shipped.

Amazon is now offering the latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3 at $199 – that’s a straight up $50 off the list price and the best around in brand new condition.

Apple’s 2026 Studio Display XDR hits all-time low at $329 off, or $500 off from Apple refurb

Just after catching a short lived all-time low on the standard model, Amazon is now delivering its best price ever on the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR at $329 off. The most affordable Apple Studio Display is also close to $100 off right now at Amazon (within a few bucks of the all-time low).

Amazon is now offering the Apple Studio Display XDR with the Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand down at $2,969.99 shipped.

You’re looking at a premium $3,299 Apple Display here sitting down at the lowest price we have ever tracked.

Just keep in mind, you can also score this same model from the official Apple Refurb Store right now down at $2,799 shipped. That’s $500 off the list and a seriously great price for this thing. It is, however only $171 less than the brand new unit at Amazon though – that’s not a small amount of cash by any means, but when you’re spending this much already it is worth consideration.

Apple deals starting to disappear, grab AirTag 2 at the best price ever ($20 each)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $80 (Reg. $99) – NEW all-time low

Most affordable current-gen iPad Air now $100 off at Amazon, more up to $149 off

As part of its ongoing Labor Day sale, Amazon is delivering some discounts across the latest M4 iPad Air lineup. Most notably for me, the least expensive model in the lineup is now $100 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air down at $649 shipped.

Regularly $749, this is $100 off the list price and the lowest we can find. While we have seen a couple very short-lived offers that lasted hardly an hour for less, this is otherwise on par with the lowest we have tracked in the last couple months on the least expensive model in the lineup.

Another notable option on sale for Labor Day right now is the 1TB 13-inch M4 iPad Air. While clearly a much more expensive option, you can score this one at $149 off the list price right now. It is sitting at $1,399.99 shipped from the regular $1,549.

You’ll find a few other configs seeing solid price drops right now below:

M4 iPad Air 13-inch

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

Alongside the Labor Day sales now live at Best Buy and Amazon, we are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My, heart rate tracking, more now up to $92 off

With the massive Labor Day Sales rolling at Amazon and Best Buy, as well as a solid $50 price drop now live on AirPods Pro 3, we are also seeing the latest Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 at $50 off. You can score them for even less ($92 off) via Best Buy “excellent” open-box listings.

Amazon is now offering the Jet Black Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 noise cancelling buds with Find My and heart rate tracking down at $199.95 shipped.

Regularly $250, that’s $50 off to match our previous mention and land within $20 of the all-time low. It is also the same $50 price drop we are tracking on Apple’s latest and greatest AirPods Pro 3.

However, if you’re looking to score a set at an even lower price, Best Buy’s “excellent” condition open-box price is sitting down at $157.99 shipped right now. That’s $92 off the new list price and the best we can find in this condition from a reputable dealer.

  • Fully functional & works like new
  • Looks like new
  • Includes all parts and accessories.
  • Packaging may vary or be absent.

Yes, you can score the AirPods Pro 3 for $1 less right now, but if you are looking towards the more workout-focused vibe of the Powerbeats Pro 2, there are some notable deals here.
